blocks.html: The 3rd Sunday of June marks the celebration of Father’s Day – a time where you show your love and gratitude to all fathers and father-figures after all the things they have done. Though you don’t get to spend so much time with your fathers unlike with your mothers, they still deserve to receive the same amount of love as they worked long and hard to provide all your needs (and even wants). So in honor of the man who you consider as the King of the family, how do you say “Thank You”? For one, a trip to a nearby mall to buy the perfect gift for your dad or participate in different activities should be on your list. Robinsons Malls has prepared the perfect activities for your dad’s special day such as the Fitness activities & games at Robinsons Manila and a series of fun & exciting treats at Robinsons Otis, Robinsons Galleria and Robinsons Las Piñas. For the music-loving dads, Robinsons Antipolo will hold a PLDT Home Fibr Mini Concert on their special day featuring Asia’s Songbird, Ms. Regine Velasquez-Alcasid while Robinsons Town Mall Malabon will have a mall show featuring “The Bloomfields” and their signature renditions of the 60’s and 80’s rock music. If your dad has a knack for repairing things and loves all tool-related stuff, then bring him to Robinsons Metro East as it holds a Power Tool Festival from Handyman. If your dad adores cars and big bikes, then bring him to Forum Robinsons for an interactive bike display by the Harley Owners Group with their selected vintage to modern Harley Davidson bikes or to Robinsons Magnolia for the Volkswagen Exhibit. Likewise, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Cybergate Bacolod, Robinsons Place Malolos and Summit Ridge Tagaytay also have their own Big Bike and Car Exhibit allowing fathers and even their sons to take souvenir photos with it. For the sporty dad, take him to Robinsons Place Angeles or at the Fiesta Kapampangan Atrium of Robinsons Starmills Pampanga as he competes in a Dart Tournament to see who the best dart player is. You can also visit Robinsons Nova Market as they compete at the “Dad Singing Idol” and shooting & fitness challenges. And for those whose dad has an active lifestyle, visit Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Place General Trias, Robinsons Place Palawan or Robinsons Cybergate Cebu, and challenge your old man as they complete obstacle courses, join the free Zumba session or compete at the inter-barangay talent competition. Other go-to malls with exciting activities this coming Father’s Day include Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños, Robinsons Ilocos Norte, Robinsons Luisita, Robinsons Place Santiago, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Sta. Rosa Market, Robinsons Place Iloilo, Robinsons Place Dumaguete, Robinsons Cebu Fuente, Robinsons Place Roxas, Robinsons Galleria Cebu, Robinsons Place GenSan, Robinsons Place Butuan, Robinsons Place Jaro and Robinsons Place Tagum. Every father deserves a recognition for being the head of the family who takes care of everyone. So celebrate Father’s Day at Robinsons Malls to crown the King of your lives.
